Jellyscribe.description: Automatically syncs your Jellyfin watch history to your Letterboxd diary (films) and Serializd diary (TV). Supports multiple users, real-time sync on playback completion, duplicate detection, retry with backoff, and TMDb-based matching.
Jellyscribe.overview: Real-time Letterboxd and Serializd diary sync with duplicate detection

versions.changelog: Jellyscribe updates the library it uses to read Letterboxd web pages, which it relies on when an account signs in through the website and when it finds films on letterboxd.com. Nothing changes in how syncing works. The website sign-in, film lookups, diary entries and ratings were all checked against letterboxd.com with the new version.

When the official sign-in does not work for an account, Jellyscribe signs in through the Letterboxd website instead. Since Letterboxd changed its sign-in page, that fallback has failed every time with "The form on this page had expired", so those accounts could not sync at all. Jellyscribe now handles the new sign-in page, so these accounts sign in, log films and save ratings again. Accounts that use the official sign-in were never affected.

Each linked diary has a new option, "Re-request watched titles", next to the other Seerr settings on both the admin page and your own page. Since 2.12.4, auto-request skips films and seasons you have already watched, so a cleanup tool deleting them does not download them again. If you want the old behaviour, for example because you rewatch and like the library to keep everything on your watchlist, turn this on for that account. It is off by default, so nothing changes unless you choose it.

When an admin edits a linked diary on the Jellyscribe settings page, the save now starts from the account as it is stored and changes only what the form shows. Before, the page rebuilt the account from scratch, so any account setting the form did not list would have been reset to its default on the next edit. Nothing is lost today, because every current setting is on the form, but future settings are now safe from the moment they ship.

Both Jellyscribe dashboards, the admin settings page and your own page, now share one script and one stylesheet instead of each carrying its own copy. The pages are about five times smaller, and the shared part, fonts included, is downloaded once per version and then cached. They look and behave exactly as before. After a plugin upgrade, an open browser tab picks up the new version the next time the page is opened, with no reload needed. When you post a review that lands on a diary entry you had already logged, the result now says so, and any note from the server is shown under that account. The design follows Wouter Stulp's shared-assets work in his fork, reworked to keep the bundled fonts and to load the right version after an upgrade.

```markdown

Reviewing a film from your activity list no longer adds a second watch to your Letterboxd diary. When the film is already in your diary from a sync, the review and its star rating now go onto that diary entry, keeping its original date. A review is never written over one you already wrote on Letterboxd: you are asked to edit that one on Letterboxd instead. If the entry can't be found, or your account is signed in through the Letterboxd website rather than the official API, the review is saved as a new entry on the day you watched the film rather than today, and the result tells you so.

The activity list now reaches your whole history. A search box above the status filters finds any title. A "Load older history" button pages back through everything Jellyscribe has logged, instead of the list quietly stopping after a couple of hundred entries. A binge of one show folds into a single row that shows the episode range and any failures, and opens with a click or the keyboard. Prev and Next switch off at the ends. The same works on the admin dashboard's overview and its Activity tab. In the account dialog, the watchlist option's description now changes when you switch a new account between Serializd and Letterboxd, and the service names read "Serializd: TV" and "Letterboxd: Film". Thanks to Wouter Stulp, whose search, episode grouping and older-history work is included.

Jellyscribe is steadier when Letterboxd or Serializd ask it to slow down. A rate-limit pause is honoured for up to a minute. Anything longer skips the film or episode until the next sync, and a Letterboxd sync that keeps hitting the limit stops early instead of trying every film. Letterboxd retries are now accepted instead of refused as a repeat. Stopping a sync, or restarting Jellyfin, no longer waits out a long pause. When you sign in with your Letterboxd website login, a TV series that Letterboxd lists as a film can no longer be mistaken for a movie with the same TMDb number, so the wrong film is never marked watched or rated. A Serializd review of an episode now lands on the same episode a log would: for a show Serializd lists as a single season, it goes to the right episode of that season, and it is refused if Serializd has no such episode. The activity lists on both dashboards show the full page they ask for again.

You can now see exactly what Jellyscribe would send before anything leaves your server. In the admin settings, Integrations has a Preview of the anonymous telemetry ping, the exact JSON, with Copy and "Copy + regenerate ID" for bug reports, and a Regenerate ID button that gives your server a fresh anonymous identity whenever you like. The admin Overview asks once whether you would like to turn telemetry on, and never again after you answer. "Send to developer" on the Logs tab now has a Preview of the full bundle, your note included, and its confirmation lists everything the bundle holds. Email addresses no longer appear in Jellyscribe's logs or in a bundle: Serializd accounts are named by a short tag, and any address in older log lines is masked. A successful review's reply is no longer written to the log, and replies that older versions logged are cut from what you can send. The telemetry description is also more precise: usage counts are rough buckets, error counts are exact per week, and an extra ping goes out at most once a day when a new kind of error starts.

The Jellyscribe pages now work properly on a phone, by keyboard and with a screen reader, and they follow your Jellyfin theme. The admin settings page no longer runs off the side of a phone screen, and on a phone each activity row shows its date under the title, an idea from Wouter Stulp. The section menu, the star rating and the account and review windows can all be used with the keyboard. The windows now behave as proper dialogs: they keep focus inside, close with Escape and return you to where you were. Every field is labelled for screen readers. Thanks to Wouter Stulp, buttons and small text are much easier to read, disabled buttons look disabled, and the pages no longer restyle the rest of Jellyfin. The pages now switch between light and dark with your Jellyfin theme instead of your device's setting, and in light mode every status colour is readable. "Back to Jellyfin" now works on servers that live under a sub-path such as /jellyfin, and returns you to the page you came from without reloading.

KometaThemes.description: KometaThemes scarica le sigle di apertura e chiusura degli anime da animethemes.moe e le mette sulle pagine di serie, stagioni e film di Jellyfin. Ogni stagione riceve le sue sigle, abbinata alle voci dello stesso franchise su animethemes.moe, i file portano il titolo del brano, e una pagina nel pannello mostra e controlla ogni abbinamento. Richiede Jellyfin 12.
KometaThemes.overview: Le sigle degli anime sulle pagine di Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Le stagioni vengono abbinate alle voci che animethemes.moe raggruppa con la serie, per data di uscita, numero di episodi, numero nel titolo e ordine del franchise: funziona anche senza AniList (la cui API è spenta dal 21 ottobre 2026) e senza date, unisce i due cour di una stessa stagione saltando i riassunti, divide una voce lunga tra più stagioni dando a ciascuna le sigle dei suoi episodi e salta film, OVA e spin-off nel mezzo. Corretto l'abbinamento per titolo, che nella 2.0 non funzionava mai: un filtro sbagliato restituiva le voci senza sigle, e un abbinamento manuale cancellava i file invece di scaricarli. La ricerca per titolo ora legge sinonimi e abbreviazioni, uniforma le traslitterazioni, usa il nome della cartella e l'anno e distingue film, serie e remake. Aperture e chiusure hanno limiti separati, quindi le serie lunghe tengono le ending; si usano le versioni che sfumano nell'episodio quando manca una pulita e si evitano i video con sottotitoli impressi. Jellyfin registra le sigle con un aggiornamento leggero che non interroga i provider di metadati. Nella pagina dell'anime un elenco Stagioni mostra come suona ogni stagione e Cambia abbinamento propone prima le voci dello stesso franchise; corrette le locandine stirate nella libreria. Tolti gli ID aniSearch, che animethemes.moe non conserva. Richiede Jellyfin 12.0 o successivo.

Versione per Jellyfin 12, con un'interfaccia nuova scritta da zero: libreria, pagina dell'anime con una scheda per stagione, mappa degli episodi, anteprima e scelta delle singole sigle, abbinamento manuale, attività, impostazioni e primo avvio guidato, più il pulsante nelle pagine degli anime. Ogni stagione riceve le sue sigle tramite i seguiti di AniList, solo quando anno ed episodi coincidono. I file prendono il titolo del brano e quelli della 1.x vengono rinominati, non riscaricati; le copie theme.mp3 duplicate vengono tolte. Corretti la sincronizzazione che ignorava gli abbinamenti manuali, il refresh completo dei metadati dopo ogni download, la sincronizzazione interrotta da un errore di rete, i tentativi infiniti sugli anime non trovati e i file cancellati a vicenda. Tolti playlist .m3u, prova a secco, preset e visualizzatore dei log. Richiede Jellyfin 12.0 o successivo.

Last.fm.overview: A plugin that scrobbles your Jellyfin music to Last.fm

versions.changelog: Consider artist id when syncing favourites
Fix for tracks without album artist metadata.
Fixed audiobooks being incorrectly treated as music and sent to Last.fm as now playing tracks, scrobbles, or favourite updates.

Scrobble log messages now include the exact data sent to Last.fm, url encoded and without the credentials, so a rejected scrobble can be replayed as is. This also covers the album artist and the MusicBrainz id, which were never logged before, and makes characters that are invisible in a log, such as non breaking spaces in artist names, easy to spot. This only changes logging, scrobbling behaviour is unchanged.

Playback events received from Jellyfin are now logged, in both the default and the alternative mode, to help debug reports of tracks that never get scrobbled. Some clients do not tell the server that a track was played or stopped, and until now there was no way to tell that apart from the plugin discarding the event. The reason a track was skipped is logged as well. This only adds logging, scrobbling behaviour is unchanged.

Scrobbles that Last.fm silently drops are now logged as warnings with the reason, instead of being reported as successful. Last.fm answers those with a normal HTTP 200 and no error code, so they were previously indistinguishable from accepted scrobbles in the logs. This does not change which scrobbles are accepted, it only makes the rejected ones visible.

This version requires Jellyfin 10.11.9 or newer. Jellyfin 10.11.9 changed an internal API the plugin relies on. Fixes the 'Import Last.fm Loved Tracks' task. Also refactored the settings page to use plugin-specific element IDs, avoiding clashes with other plugins' configuration pages - this might fix the user dropdown showing up empty for some users.

New API key and secret, since the previous one was blocked or deleted by the original project owner. After upgrading, every user will need to re-enter their credentials for the plugin to work again. There's no way to migrate the old credentials since the API key is different and we don't store the actual user password (we just use it to create a session key). This is a necessary change to keep the plugin working, since the stored session keys were generated with the previous API key that is not valid anymore.
Allowing to change the API Host (Libre.fm support) + Masking password in config page
Naming convention fixes

Live Channels.description: Live Channels lets administrators build looping virtual TV channels from genres and official ratings or from a hand-picked list of items. Each channel, its guide, and its stream are served in-process through Jellyfin's own Live TV, so the channels appear automatically with no tuner to add, no URLs to paste, and no exposed endpoints.
Live Channels.overview: Build looping virtual TV channels that appear natively in Jellyfin's Live TV.

versions.changelog:
## Features
- Multipart episodes now stay together however many parts they have, so a story told in parts 1 through 4 airs back to back instead of only the first two

## Fixed
- Viewers who stay tuned now follow the refreshed schedule after a guide refresh instead of drifting away from what the guide shows
- Items no longer get cut off as they finish, so measured durations are recorded and items line up cleanly at their seams
- A restarted stream no longer replays the last half minute of content
- The standby slate now uses the channel codecs, so HEVC and AC3 channels no longer break when they fall back to standby
- Channels with time-of-day rating blocks now land on the guide clock after the tune-in card instead of running about ten seconds behind
- Burned-in subtitle items from sources with a nonzero start time no longer jump forward at the seam
- A series recording rule no longer re-records the same unnumbered program at every airing
- Cancelling one episode of a series recording now skips that episode instead of recording it at its next airing
- Record series now picks the local day of the week instead of the UTC day
- Recordings that fail while storage is briefly unavailable now keep retrying instead of giving up after about three minutes
- Interrupted recording copies no longer leave temporary files in the library
- The stream cleanup task can no longer delete a stream that is just starting
- A channel can no longer end up with two encoders running at once
- Changing the stream directory no longer leaves later saves clearing the wrong schedule cache
- Saving settings during a guide refresh no longer gets overwritten by the old schedule
- The Popular channel now honors its audio language filter
- The channel editor no longer keeps a rejected save in memory, and warns instead of overwriting changes made in another tab
- The stress test now measures real frames produced and fails streams that exit with an error
- Settings saved through the API with empty values no longer crash the guide or streams
- Very large rating transition windows are now capped at one day instead of turning rating protection off

## Fixed
- The guide no longer shows two overlapping schedules for a channel after a refresh where any channel failed
- A guide refresh no longer changes the program on air mid-show; the current program keeps its slot and the new schedule follows it
- Shuffled series always air a full batch of episodes instead of sometimes airing a lone leftover episode
- On channels with time-of-day rating blocks, a series batch is placed whole or skipped at a rating border instead of being cut after one episode

## Fixed
- The Refresh Guide progress bar no longer jumps backwards; the earlier fix never took effect on Jellyfin 12

## Developer
- Built for Jellyfin 12.2 (target ABI 12.2.0.0). Servers on Jellyfin 12.0 or 12.1 keep the previous release.
- Updated test dependencies (Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.11, NSubstitute 6.2, xunit 2.9.3, xunit.runner.visualstudio 4.0.1).

## Fixed
- Subtitle burn-in now works for media whose folder or file name contains an apostrophe or other special characters
- Tuning back in to a channel just as its idle stream was shutting down no longer lands on a dead stream
- Channels with missing media files now start on the program the guide shows when tuning in, and tuning in no longer checks every file first
- A hung ffmpeg or ffprobe while rendering a tune-in card or logo is now stopped after a time limit instead of blocking later renders
- Tuning in no longer waits for the channel logo to be generated
- A recording now captures the item that was scheduled when the timer was set, even if the channel's schedule changed since
- An unexpected error in the background session cleanup is now logged instead of stopping the server
- Saving plugin-wide settings such as bitrate no longer reshuffles time-of-day channel schedules
- Channel logos written by several requests at once no longer go missing
- The documentation now notes that the Popular channel's shared guide reflects every user's watch history and is not filtered per user

## Developer
- Updated JPKribs.Jellyfin.Base to 2026.10.19.

## Developer
- Updated JPKribs.Jellyfin.Base to 2026.10.16.

## User
- The Refresh Guide progress is now more accurate

## User
- Channels now direct play on clients that support the stream instead of always being remuxed or transcoded by the server

## Developer
- The opened source now sets SupportsDirectPlay. PlaybackInfo always disables direct stream (MediaInfoHelper), so a source that only allowed direct stream could never be picked and every tune-in fell back to DirectPlayError and a remux

## User
- A channel with no viewers now stops when its countdown reaches zero. It used to run on for two to three minutes after the last viewer left
- Tune-in cards are generated for every channel shortly after the server starts and at every guide refresh, including the refresh a save triggers, so a fresh install, an update, a new logo, or changed output settings never leave a channel opening without its card

## Developer
- The linger teardown was vetoed every time because the Jellyfin reader is served right up to the close, so the two-minute recent-delivery rule always saw a viewer at the 30s mark, and the one-shot task then gave up until the reaper backstop 90s plus a minute later. A lingering session now only counts delivery after the close (DeliveryCountsAsWatched, unit tested), and LingerTeardownAsync retries every 5s until the reaper threshold
- LiveChannelsTvService sweeps the tune-in cards 20s after construction and from every GetChannelsAsync (EnsureLogoAsync then IntroService.EnsureAsync per enabled channel, serialised, logged with its trigger); a tune-in without a card now logs it
- The Sessions tab countdown wording no longer uses an em dash or a semicolon

## User
- Tune-in is now immediate. A channel opens on a short animated card (its logo and a Starting Channel caption over flowing lines) the moment you tune in, while the content is seeked and encoded behind it, and the picture no longer waits ten seconds or more for a buffer to fill first
- The Start-up buffer setting is gone. It turned out to be a literal pause Jellyfin applied before every tune-in rather than a buffer, and the cushion it was meant to provide is now built up while you are already watching

## Developer
- Removed StartupBufferSeconds and BufferMs (Jellyfin sleeps for BufferMs in TranscodeManager.AcquireResources before launching the delivery ffmpeg, on every tune-in including adoption)
- The tune-in handover now waits for the playlist and one segment instead of the full cushion, and the endpoint reader's hold-back ramps in one segment per ten seconds of session age instead of applying from the first byte
- Segments and the encoder GOP are now three seconds, matching Jellyfin's delivery remux so every stage cuts on the same keyframes

## Developer
- Bump base to 2026.07.31
- Rebuilt for Jellyfin 12.0 on .NET 10, with the target ABI raised to 12.0.0.0
- The dashboard menu entry now shows a live_tv icon instead of the generic folder
- CI builds, tests, and CodeQL now run on .NET 10, and label sync has the token scope it needs

versions.changelog:
- Administrators can now copy central groups into their own personal collection when switching back to personal mode, or import them later. Both management screens require an explicit copy/skip choice on mode switch. Existing personal groups take precedence when IDs match; central groups and other users' personal groups remain untouched. Custom group images are copied with newly imported groups.
- Require administrators to explicitly choose whether to copy their personal groups when switching to central management. The no-copy choice preserves personal groups for later use, and both the web dialog and plugin dashboard offer a later import. Reject an ambiguous mode-switch request instead of silently showing an empty central group list.

- Support Wholphin in the native Live TV guide: select a group or **All channels** directly in its compatible Control Center folders, then open **Live TV → TV Guide**. Group selection applies only to the authenticated user's device, respects current group/channel permissions, and restores the full guide on reset. Wholphin does not support an automatic guide jump.
- Add administrator switches for the official Jellyfin Android TV / Fire TV app and Wholphin. A sole eligible TV is selected automatically; with several TVs, the last available choice is remembered per user. Disabled or disconnected devices cannot receive playback or guide changes.
- Add recognizable artwork to the Control Center home tile, guide actions, confirmation and fallback folders. **All channels** has its own EPG-reset image; created groups have a distinct group image. Personal and shared groups can use custom PNG, JPEG or WebP images up to 5 MiB, with preview and reset controls and permission checks.
- Add recording controls to the grouped web EPG. Users with Jellyfin's Live TV management permission can schedule, edit and cancel single-program or series timers, including padding and series options; recording errors remain visible in the dialog.
- Restore reliable loading of the independent web EPG behind reverse proxies that cached its old script URL. Preserve original channel logos, official Android TV / Fire TV behavior, channel playback and the existing plugin identity and settings.

- Selecting a group in the official Android TV / Fire TV app immediately applies that group's native guide scope and opens the ordinary Live TV view. The separate Native TV guide action remains available to retry.
- Hide direct grouped-channel media tiles from that authenticated TV response while keeping the native guide action and browsable program-list fallback. Internal channel items and playlists remain unchanged.
- Retain per-user/device validation, group access checks and safe behavior when navigation is unavailable. The original app may still require selecting TV Guide after opening Live TV; a direct timeline deep link is not exposed by the stock client.

- Organize Live TV channels in ordered personal groups independent of IPTV-provider categories, or use administrator-managed shared groups with per-group user access.
- Show one selected group's original channels in Jellyfin's native Android TV / Fire TV timeline. Select the group on the TV or from the web/mobile page; the web page can also apply the deduplicated union of all visible groups. Reset to all ordinarily permitted channels at any time. Selections are per user and TV device.
- Browse an independent web EPG with a channel/program timeline, now/next/later programs, channel cards, day/time navigation and zoom. Save visible/default groups and view preferences; use the interface in English or German.
- Use the web or phone guide as a remote for the official Jellyfin Android TV / Fire TV app: discover a compatible TV, remember the target, and start or switch live channels while the guide stays open.
- Apply optional central channel-access rules to selected users, including children's accounts. Restrictions cover the plugin and ordinary Jellyfin Live TV, direct playback, playlists and associated recordings while preserving Jellyfin permissions.
- Browse grouped channel and daily program folders in supported native apps; optionally mirror groups as playlists for other clients.
- Integrate the web interface through File Transformation, optionally add a Plugin Pages menu shortcut, customize the display name and hide the original Live TV home tile when the groups entry is available.
- Support Jellyfin 12.0 or later in the Jellyfin 12 series (12.1 confirmed). Keep the existing plugin ID, channel identity and stored settings for upgrades from Live-TV Groups. Native guide navigation may require one additional TV Guide selection; no virtual channels or custom TV client are used.

versions.changelog:
Jellyfin 10.11.9+ compatibility and recommendation-quality fixes
- Fixes MissingMethodException crash on Jellyfin 10.11.9/10.11.10 (#17, fixes #21): all IUserManager.Users call sites now use GetUsers()
- TV series now weighted by most recently watched episode date instead of always 'today' (#19)
- Replaced play-count rewatch boost with recency-driven Recent Watch Emphasis using decay-squared amplification (#20); the RewatchBoost setting becomes RecentWatchBoost (default 1.0)
- Config page numeric fields saved as 0 no longer revert to defaults (#22)
- REQUIRES Jellyfin 10.11.9 or newer

Migrate from .strm files to filesystem symlinks (#13)
- Fixes transcoded playback on Jellyfin 10.11.7+ (GHSA-j2hf-x4q5-47j3)
- Symlinks preserve source extensions; media pipeline treats them as regular files
- Artwork symlinked from source folder (propagates custom posters automatically)
- Trailer discovery delegated to Jellyfin's native scanner
- Removed ImageSyncService and EnableImageSync/SyncBackdrops settings
- WINDOWS: requires Administrator or Developer Mode enabled for symlink creation

Filter recommendations by user library access (#10)
- Items from libraries a user cannot access are excluded from recommendations
- Applies to both personalized and cold-start recommendation paths
- Respects per-user library permissions including disabled libraries

Fix playback freeze when playing from recommendation libraries (#8)
- Never remove virtual library items from event handlers (deferred to next refresh)
- Ignore PlaybackStart/PlaybackProgress events to prevent DB write storms during playback
- Only sync play status on meaningful events (PlaybackFinished, TogglePlayed, etc.)
- Known tradeoff: partially watched items may appear in Continue Watching twice until next refresh

Bug fixes for series recommendations and playback crashes
- Fixed: Partially watched series not included in watch history, causing all users to get identical cold-start recommendations (#7)
- Fixed: Playback from recommendation libraries crashing with database failures (#8)
- Series watch history now detected at episode level instead of requiring all episodes watched
- Virtual library items no longer removed during active playback

Image sync for custom posters and backdrops
- Custom poster images are now preserved in recommendation libraries
- Copies poster.jpg and backdrop.jpg from source items to virtual folders
- Configurable: Enable/disable image sync and backdrop copying
- Fixes issue where user customizations (e.g., French posters) were lost

Decade-based temporal similarity and bug fix
- Recommendations now consider content from similar time periods
- Decade grouping (1980s, 1990s, etc.) replaces continuous year normalization
- Improves temporal relevance alongside genre/actor/director similarity
- Tested with production data: ~12 decades extracted from 970 items
- Observable impact: 24% of movie recommendations changed, 8% of TV
- Fixed: In-progress TV series no longer appear in recommendations

Series filtering fix and play status sync
- Fixed fully watched series appearing in recommendations
- Play status sync from source library when virtual items are scanned
- Rating proximity scoring feature
- Removed NFO file generation (Jellyfin doesn't read NFO for .strm files)
- Reduced debug logging noise

Fix NFO metadata parsing
- Fixed XML encoding (UTF-16 to UTF-8) so Jellyfin reads runtime correctly
- Added cast, directors, and writers to NFO files
- Added fileinfo/streamdetails for video/audio/subtitle stream selectors

NFO metadata and trailer support
- NFO files with full metadata (runtime, ratings, genres, studios, tags)
- Local trailer support via -trailer.strm files
- Movie folder structure for better metadata handling
- Fixed copy buttons on setup page
- Improved documentation

versions.changelog:
## v1.7.2.0
### Fixes
- When LRCLIB rate limits a request, the plugin now waits as long as LRCLIB asks before moving on to the next song. It also backs off on 503 errors now. Thanks to @tranxuanthang -> #61
- Songs that got rate limited are no longer marked as "no lyrics found". Before, they were skipped for days.
- The lyrics task stops early when LRCLIB keeps rate limiting it. The next run continues where it stopped. -> #60

## v1.7.1.0
### New
- Redesigned settings page.
- New "Remove plain lyrics that hide synced lyrics" option, on by default. Turn it off if other apps use the lyrics files in your music folder.
### Fixes
- Synced lyrics now show up even when a plain .txt sits next to the song. Before, Jellyfin kept showing the plain lyrics and the task re-downloaded the synced ones every run. -> #59

## v1.7.0.0
### New
- Jellyfin 12 support. Every release now ships two builds, one for Jellyfin 12 and one for Jellyfin 10.11, and Jellyfin installs the right one for your server automatically.
- Jellyfin 10.11.0 and newer are supported again. The previous release required at least 10.11.6.
- New "Disable rate limiting" option for self-hosted LRCLIB servers. It removes the delay between requests, which speeds up large libraries. Requests to the public lrclib.net stay rate limited.
### Fixes
- Tracks that only have an album artist tag (compilations, classical music, many rips) now get lyrics. Strict search used to give up without an artist tag, and fuzzy search ignored the album artist entirely.
- Fuzzy search now tries every artist tagged on a track instead of only the first one.
- A system clock jump (NTP correction, VM resume) can no longer stall lyric requests.

## v1.6.6.0
### Fixes
- The lyrics task no longer re-downloads tracks that already have synced lyrics on disk. When a track's lyrics were saved but the database still reported them as plain (Jellyfin doesn't refresh metadata after a download until the next library scan), the task kept "upgrading" the same tracks on every run. It now trusts the synced .lrc file already on disk and skips it. -> #43

## v1.6.5.0
### Fixes
- Build against Jellyfin 10.11.6 instead of always the latest release. Previous builds were linked against 10.11.10 assemblies, which made Jellyfin report the plugin as "not supported" (TypeLoadException) on older 10.11.x servers. The plugin is now compatible with Jellyfin 10.11.6 and newer. -> #55

## v1.6.4.0
### Fixes
- Lyric file detection now also checks Jellyfin's internal metadata folder, not just the media folder. With "Save lyrics into media folders" disabled, already-downloaded lyrics are detected instead of being re-downloaded on every task run, which also reduces load on lrclib.net -> #54

## v1.6.3.0
### What's New
- Optional self-hosted LRCLIB server URL: point the plugin at your own LRCLIB instance instead of lrclib.net. Subpath URLs are preserved and the URL is validated on save. Thanks to @Nausi-llon (#50).
- Built-in rate limiting for lrclib.net requests: enforces a 200 ms minimum gap between calls and honors HTTP 429 `Retry-After` so transient spikes back off cleanly instead of surfacing as per-track errors.
- Identifiable User-Agent on every lrclib request (`jellyfin-plugin-lyrics/<version> (+repo-url)`) so the LRCLIB operators can distinguish this plugin from `jellyfin/jellyfin-plugin-lrclib` (#49).

### Notes
- No configuration changes required for existing users — the self-host URL defaults to `https://lrclib.net` and the rate limit only kicks in under load.

## v1.6.2.0
### What's New
- Auto-removes the official "LrcLib Lyrics" plugin (`jellyfin-plugin-lrclib`) on startup if installed, since both plugins register the same lyrics provider and conflict. This plugin is a fork that fixes critical issues — see README. The old plugin can be reinstalled later to switch back.

## v1.6.1.0
### What's New
- Lyrics alternative discovery: skip re-downloading lyrics that already failed in a previous run
- Synced-lyric upgrade now checks the existing sidecar file before replacing plain text

### Fixes
- Stop matching instrumental tracks against unrelated songs: honor LRCLIB's instrumental flag, validate every match against requested duration and artist, and drop the track-name-only fuzzy fallback when artist info is available (#40)
- Scheduled task log: split DB-desync skips from "already synced" skips so plain `.txt` sidecars are no longer counted as synced

### Settings
- New configurable duration-tolerance filter (default on, ±15s) with UI toggle to tune or disable

### Notes
- Jellyfin 10.11.6 or newer is now recommended (see README)

## v1.6.0.0
### What's New
- Added song title cleanup to strip YouTube-style suffixes (Official Music Video, etc.) and duplicate artist names
- Added progressive search fallback: retries with fewer parameters when no results are found
- Added multi-artist support: splits "artist1/artist2" and tries each artist individually
- Replace non-synced lyrics with synced ones when available
- Sped up scheduled lyrics task

### Fixes
- Fixed DI issue with RetryStateStore causing plugin to malfunction on startup
- Fixed fuzzy search failing when album name is missing
- Fixed crash on missing artist or invalid id

### Defaults Changed
- Strict search is now disabled by default
- "Exclude album name" is now enabled by default

MDBList.description: Syncs watched status and ratings two-way between Jellyfin and MDBList, and pushes library/collection membership to MDBList. Uses MDBList's incremental sync API (last_activities + journal) for cheap, cursor-based updates instead of full-library reconciliation on every run.
MDBList.overview: Two-way sync of watched status and ratings, plus collection sync, against MDBList

versions.changelog:
1.0.0.17: New: optionally send your files' media info (resolution, HDR, audio, channels, 3D) with collection sync, per user and off by default. Progress scrobbles now pause when MDBList's rate limit is hit, until it resets, and stop for a playback whose title MDBList doesn't recognize. Fixed every sync failing once the plugin hadn't synced for 30 days; it now runs a full sync instead.

1.0.0.16: Fixed the first watched sync sending the whole Jellyfin history to MDBList if something was marked watched before it ran, and watched changes made during a sync (e.g. marking a whole season) being pushed only on the next full sync.

1.0.0.15: Fixed every activity-triggered sync running a slow full watched sync after a sync that held back unwatching items, and full watched syncs rewriting every already-synced item. The debug log now names each held-back item and each live watched change sent to MDBList.

1.0.0.14: Fixed the first watched sync sending the whole Jellyfin watch history to MDBList, which re-dated watches and could un-drop dropped shows. It now pulls MDBList's history first and only sends what MDBList doesn't have.

1.0.0.13: Fixed a watch then unwatch (or rating then removal) pulled from MDBList in the same sync only applying the first change, and changes pulled before a failed sync being pushed back on the next sync.

1.0.0.12: Fixed ratings changed or removed in MDBList being pushed back: after a sync pulled a rating from MDBList, the next sync sent it back as a new local rating, which could undo a later change there. Pulled ratings are now recorded as synced.

1.0.0.11: Fixed an item unwatched in MDBList staying watched: after a sync pulled a watched state from MDBList, the next sync pushed it back as a new local watch, undoing a later unwatch in MDBList. Pulled changes are now recorded as synced.

1.0.0.10: Scrobbles and watched sync now send each episode's own tvdb/tmdb id, so MDBList records the exact episode even when the library numbers it differently from TMDb (common for anime with TheTVDB metadata). Season/episode numbers remain the fallback.

1.0.0.9: Fixes watched/ratings sync missing episodes for shows where a different season/episode numbering is used than MDBList's own data (a common mismatch for anime, e.g. between TheTVDB and TMDb). Episodes are now matched by their own tmdb/tvdb id first, before falling back to season/episode number.

1.0.0.8: Disconnecting an MDBList account now wipes that user's sync bookkeeping, so reconnecting (same or a different account) does a clean full resync instead of diffing against a stale or foreign baseline. Adds Debug-level logging of the full-vs-incremental pull decision, cursor value, and fetched/skipped item counts for watched and ratings pulls, to make sync behavior easier to diagnose.

1.0.0.7: Fixes a rare failure mode where a sync running right after Jellyfin starts, during a library scan, or against a temporarily unreadable library could be misread as "everything was removed" and push that as a mass removal to MDBList (or, in the reverse direction, mark a batch of items unwatched locally). Removals are now only ever applied on a deliberate sync (the 24h scheduled sync or manual "Sync now"), and a suspiciously empty or oversized removal batch is held and retried on the next sync instead of applied.

1.0.0.6: Fixes hitting MDBList's rate limit on a large first sync -- requests are now paced under the server's short-window write budget, and a 429 is retried using the server's own requested wait instead of aborting the whole sync. Also fixes losing sync progress if a run is interrupted: push progress is now saved per-batch instead of only at the end, so a later failure no longer forces redoing already-pushed items.

1.0.0.5: Fixes watched-status sync: a rewatch that only updated the watch date (without changing watched/unwatched membership) could be silently dropped by the scheduled full sync, and would only reach MDBList via the immediate live-playback push.

1.0.0.4: Fixes a build issue where the plugin was compiled against a newer Jellyfin ABI (10.11.11) than the declared minimum (10.11.0), causing installs to fail with "Status: NotSupported" on Jellyfin 10.11.1 through 10.11.10.

1.0.0.3: Fixes "Disconnect" always showing a failure alert even though it always succeeded. Updates the plugin catalog icon to a full-bleed 16:9 image instead of a square logo that Jellyfin's plugin page was cropping.

1.0.0.2: Fixes the plugin catalog icon's URL -- 1.0.0.1 published one with no host, which Jellyfin couldn't fetch at all.

1.0.0.1: Fixes scheduled syncs, "Sync now", and live scrobbling only ever acting on the first linked user when multiple Jellyfin users each have their own MDBList account connected. Adds a plugin catalog icon.

1.0.0.5: Fixes watched-status sync: a rewatch that only updated the watch date (without changing watched/unwatched membership) could be silently dropped by the scheduled full sync, and would only reach MDBList via the immediate live-playback push.

1.0.0.4: Fixes a build issue where the plugin was compiled against a newer Jellyfin ABI (10.11.11) than the declared minimum (10.11.0), causing installs to fail with "Status: NotSupported" on Jellyfin 10.11.1 through 10.11.10.

1.0.0.3: Fixes "Disconnect" always showing a failure alert even though it always succeeded. Updates the plugin catalog icon to a full-bleed 16:9 image instead of a square logo that Jellyfin's plugin page was cropping.

1.0.0.2: Fixes the plugin catalog icon's URL -- 1.0.0.1 published one with no host, which Jellyfin couldn't fetch at all.

1.0.0.1: Fixes scheduled syncs, "Sync now", and live scrobbling only ever acting on the first linked user when multiple Jellyfin users each have their own MDBList account connected. Adds a plugin catalog icon.

1.0.0.0: Initial release. Two-way sync of watched status and ratings, push-only collection sync, live playback scrobbling to MDBList's /scrobble endpoints, OAuth device-code authentication, incremental cursor-based pulls with automatic full-reconciliation fallback, a 24h scheduled full sync plus a 15-minute activity-gated cheap poll, and a config page for connecting your account and choosing what to sync.

1.0.0.9: Fixes watched/ratings sync missing episodes for shows where a different season/episode numbering is used than MDBList's own data (a common mismatch for anime, e.g. between TheTVDB and TMDb). Episodes are now matched by their own tmdb/tvdb id first, before falling back to season/episode number.

1.0.0.8: Disconnecting an MDBList account now wipes that user's sync bookkeeping, so reconnecting (same or a different account) does a clean full resync instead of diffing against a stale or foreign baseline. Adds Debug-level logging of the full-vs-incremental pull decision, cursor value, and fetched/skipped item counts for watched and ratings pulls, to make sync behavior easier to diagnose.

1.0.0.7: Fixes a rare failure mode where a sync running right after Jellyfin starts, during a library scan, or against a temporarily unreadable library could be misread as "everything was removed" and push that as a mass removal to MDBList (or, in the reverse direction, mark a batch of items unwatched locally). Removals are now only ever applied on a deliberate sync (the 24h scheduled sync or manual "Sync now"), and a suspiciously empty or oversized removal batch is held and retried on the next sync instead of applied.

MaintenanceDeluxe.description: Premium cinema-themed maintenance overlay for Jellyfin. Full-screen velours-and-gold overlay with a drifting aurora background, a rotating film-reel logo, crackling ember particles and a brushed-metal card border. versions.changelog: v0.9.0 - Grande passe de durcissement issue d'un 3e audit ultra-complet (10 dimensions, revue adversariale multi-agents) : 6 corrections MEDIUM + ~29 durcissements LOW, 0 critique/eleve restant. Recommandee. PAS DE MIGRATION. Compatible Jellyfin 10.11.10 et 10.11.11. MEDIUM : (1) coller un emoji au ras d'une limite de longueur pouvait faire echouer la sauvegarde de config (500 ; troncature UTF-16 rune-safe) ; (2) annuler l'avertissement 'utilisateurs en streaming' n'efface plus silencieusement les modifs de l'onglet Maintenance et n'affiche plus un faux succes ; (3) modales Uptime Kuma / Import accessibles (role=dialog, focus piege, Echap, focus restitue) ; (4) reordonnancement des lignes au clavier (fleches haut/bas) ; (5) la couche d'enforcement anti-SSRF des webhooks est desormais couverte par des tests ; (6) le pipeline de release verifie que l'URL d'asset du manifest correspond (anti-typo de casse type v0.6.0). LOW notables : anti lost-update entre onglets, purge des utilisateurs supprimes du suivi 'vu', tailles de boutons bornees, coherence de planning fixe C#/JS, ARIA onglets + navigation fleches, contrastes et cibles tactiles WCAG, garde double-execution du script injecte, un seul fetch /maintenance par navigation, test de reflexion des tiers d'autorisation, coherence de version sur 4 sources. + 2 liens de documentation corriges. 391 tests verts, build 0 warning.

v0.8.5 - Corrections UX/a11y/fonctionnel issues d'un 2e audit ultra-complet (toutes couches : UX, design, perf, code, a11y, docs ; 0 critique restant, 6 high corriges ici). Recommande. HIGH : (1) les modeles rapides d'annonce (ex : Halloween/Noel 'annuel') perdaient silencieusement leur planning / auto-expiration / theme / image -> l'annonce s'affichait toute l'annee au lieu de sa fenetre ; desormais tous les champs sont copies. (2) L'overlay de maintenance plein ecran a enfin la meme accessibilite que les modales d'annonce : role=dialog + aria-modal, focus piege a l'interieur, scroll de la page verrouille, focus restitue a la fermeture (avant : un utilisateur clavier/lecteur d'ecran pouvait tabuler derriere l'overlay). (3) En mode carousel, les cartes non visitees n'etaient jamais marquees 'vues' -> le carousel reapparaissait a chaque connexion ; maintenant toutes les cartes sont marquees a la fermeture. (4) Un redemarrage programme a la fin de la fenetre de maintenance etait annule silencieusement par la desactivation auto du meme tick -> il se declenche desormais correctement. (5) `make bump` (outil de dev) etait casse sur GNU sed (Git Bash / CI Linux). (6) README : exigence Jellyfin corrigee 10.11.6 -> 10.11.10. MEDIUM : cap sur le NOMBRE d'elements des collections (annonces 200 / messages 100 / etc.) anti-bloat config.xml ; image hero d'annonce masquee si l'URL est morte (plus d'icone cassee) ; pluralisation '1 annonce'. TESTS : 366/366 verts (+3 caps), build 0 warning, revue adversariale multi-agents (aucune regression critique/elevee). Compatible Jellyfin 10.11.10 et 10.11.11. PAS DE MIGRATION.

v0.8.4 - Release de SECURITE + corrections (suite a un audit adverse multi-agents). Recommande pour tous. SECURITE (webhook SSRF, durci sur 3 couches) : la defense SSRF de v0.7.0 etait contournable. Corrige : (1) le HttpClient webhook suivait les redirections HTTP -> un hote public autorise pouvait renvoyer un 302 vers 169.254.169.254 (metadata cloud) / loopback / LAN ; desormais AllowAutoRedirect=false + un ConnectCallback qui re-valide l'IP REELLE de chaque connexion (bat aussi le DNS rebinding). (2) les litteraux IPv6-mappes (::ffff:169.254.169.254) et les hotes a point final (127.0.0.1.) contournaient la blocklist -> normalisation MapToIPv4 + trailing-dot. (3) ajout des plages ::, CGNAT 100.64/10, fec0::/10, broadcast. NB : configurer un webhook reste admin-only (RequiresElevation), donc l'attaque exige un admin malveillant ou piege. CORRECTIONS (audit) : (a) la desactivation manuelle de la maintenance n'est plus annulee par le planificateur (consommation du ScheduledStart passe + garde ScheduledEnd) ; (b) ajouter un user a la whitelist PENDANT la maintenance le reactive immediatement, le drift-check respecte la whitelist live ; (c) modele de concurrence APPLIQUE : tous les writers de config (SaveConfig/SaveMaintenance/SaveAdminAnnouncements/MarkSeen/ResetSeen + tache planifiee) passent par un verrou unique -> fin des pertes d'ecriture et du config.xml corrompu ; (d) les annonces recurrentes (daily/weekly/annual) sont evaluees en heure LOCALE serveur (etait UTC) -> elles s'affichent aux bonnes heures, alignees sur les bannieres (positionne le TZ du conteneur) ; (e) cap sur la taille de reponse webhook (anti-OOM) + try/catch global sur la tache planifiee ; (f) admin.js : fix d'une fuite de listeners (double-binding a chaque pageshow). CI : la garde ASCII attrape desormais U+2028/2029/0085 ; release.yml lance dotnet test avant de publier ; creation de release idempotente. TESTS : 363/363 verts (etait 316), correctifs SSRF mutation-verifies, revue adversariale multi-agents (aucune regression critique/elevee). PAS DE MIGRATION.

v0.8.3 - Release de durcissement qualite (reponse a un audit adverse). AUCUN changement de feature, AUCUN changement de comportement du plugin shippe : le DLL est fonctionnellement identique a v0.8.2. La seule modif du code shippe est un refactor interne behavior-preserving (extraction de MaintenanceHelper.SetUserDisabledAsync, la glue IUserManager.GetUserDto+UpdatePolicyAsync, factorisee depuis les 3 boucles activate/deactivate/drift-check) verifie equivalent par mutation testing. Tout le reste est de l'infra de test/CI qui ne part PAS dans le zip : (1) Garde anti-tests-vacuous via Stryker.NET (mutation testing) sur les helpers de logique pure (AnnouncementHelper + MaintenanceHelper), workflow dedie manuel+hebdo, seuil de non-regression. (2) +21 tests xUnit (295 -> 316) : durcissement HasUserSeen/MarkSeen, round-trip XML de PluginConfiguration (compat legacy + champs non-null), builders de payload webhook Discord/Slack/Generic, vecteurs XSS sur SAFE_URL_RE, et surtout 15 tests d'integration HTTP qui pilotent SaveConfig/SaveMaintenance/SaveAdminAnnouncements a travers un VRAI Plugin (BasePlugin sur dossier temp + XmlSerializer reel) avec preuve de persistance disque. (3) Smoke test de deploiement reel qui gate les releases : boot d'un vrai serveur Jellyfin (matrix 10.11.6 plancher targetAbi + 10.11.10 prod) avec le DLL monte, completion du wizard, auth admin, puis appel de /users-summary et /announcements/admin (les endpoints qui appellent IUserManager.GetUsers() - EXACTEMENT la methode qui crashait en MissingMethodException sur 10.11.9) + scan des logs serveur. Ce gate aurait attrape le bug v0.8.0 avant publication. TESTS : 316/316 verts sur SDK 10.11.10, refactor mutation-verifie (24/24 + nouveaux KILLED). PAS DE MIGRATION. Recommande pour 10.11.10+ ; equivalent fonctionnel a v0.8.2.

v0.8.2 - Compat refresh Jellyfin 10.11.10. Aucun changement de code, aucun changement de feature : juste un rebuild contre le SDK Jellyfin 10.11.10 (release patch sortie cote serveur) + bump targetAbi de 10.11.9.0 a 10.11.10.0 pour que Jellyfin 10.11.10+ accepte l'install sans warning. AUDIT API : diff complet de IUserManager + ISessionManager entre 10.11.9 et 10.11.10 = 0 difference, toutes les methodes utilisees (GetUsers, GetUserById, GetUserByName, GetUserDto, UpdatePolicyAsync, Sessions) ont signature identique. v0.8.1 (build 10.11.9) marche aussi sur 10.11.10 grace a la forward-compat Jellyfin meme-minor, mais ce binaire v0.8.2 est strictement aligne sur la derniere API. TESTS : 279/279 verts sur SDK 10.11.10. PAS DE MIGRATION. Si tu es sur Jellyfin <= 10.11.8, reste sur v0.8.0. Si tu es sur 10.11.9, v0.8.1 ou v0.8.2 marchent les deux. Si tu es sur 10.11.10+, v0.8.2 recommande.

v0.8.1 - HOTFIX CRITIQUE Jellyfin 10.11.9 : la propriete IUserManager.Users a ete supprimee dans Jellyfin 10.11.x (breaking change patch) au profit de la methode GetUsers(). Le plugin v0.8.0 (build contre SDK 10.11.6) crashait avec MissingMethodException 'Method not found: ... IUserManager.get_Users()' sur les routes /MaintenanceDeluxe/users-summary, /MaintenanceDeluxe/announcements/admin, et lors de l'activation maintenance (MaintenanceHelper.ActivateAsync). Pire : les exceptions remontaient dans les handlers ItemAdded/Updated/Removed de Jellyfin (via la stack DI partagee), cassant des fonctionnalites core du serveur. Fix : (1) bump Jellyfin.Controller + Jellyfin.Model de 10.11.6 -> 10.11.9 (csproj plugin ET csproj tests). (2) Remplacement de _userManager.Users par _userManager.GetUsers() sur 3 call sites : BannerController.GetUsersSummary (ligne 549), BannerController.GetAdminAnnouncements (ligne 704), MaintenanceHelper.ActivateAsync (ligne 138). (3) targetAbi du manifest passe de 10.11.6.0 a 10.11.9.0 - les serveurs Jellyfin sur 10.11.6/7/8 ne pourront plus installer v0.8.1+ via le manifest (downgrade SDK pas backward-compatible). Si tu es sur 10.11.6-8, reste sur v0.8.0 ou upgrade Jellyfin. TESTS : 279/279 verts sur le nouveau SDK 10.11.9 (aucune logique modifiee, juste l'API de IUserManager). PAS D'AUTRE CHANGEMENT cote feature - c'est strictement un hotfix de compat ABI.

v0.8.0 - Tour de fixes a11y + UX + CI robustesse (4 agents en parallele, +13 tests = 279 verts). A11Y: (1) Focus trap dans toutes les modales (dangerConfirm admin + showAnnouncementModal + Carousel + Stack banner.js) - Tab/Shift+Tab cycle dans la modale, capture/restore du document.activeElement. (2) Scroll lock body lors d'affichage modale annonce (overflow:hidden sur documentElement+body, restore au close). (3) Compteur carousel SR-friendly - counterEl cree une fois hors render() avec aria-atomic=true, mutation via textContent au lieu d'innerHTML wipe. (4) prefers-reduced-motion respecte (theme neon pulse, badge dirty pulse, jfDconfFade overlay animation, preview neon glow). (5) Contraste WCAG AA sur badges - draft #E8A33D->#FFD27A + opacity 0.18->0.28, expired #D9534F->#FF8A87 + opacity 0.15->0.30, expiring + schedule-incomplete aussi rehausses. (6) Touch targets 44x44 minimum sur .jf-dconf-btn (padding 8->12) et .jf-url-btn (padding 7->12 + min-height 44 + inline-flex). (7) Focus visible outline doree sur les inputs .jf-ann-field. (8) backdrop-filter fallback solide via @supports not (backdrop-filter) - fallback opaque pour vieux Chromium TV. UX: (9) Webhook test button desactive pendant la requete avec texte 'Test en cours...', reenable() partage entre then/catch. (10) Import config: _pendingImport=null sur Cancel/ESC/backdrop, garde Apply qui affiche feedback si pas de fichier selectionne, closeImportModal() centralise. (11) Release notes delete confirmation via dangerConfirm si la section a du contenu (titre/body/icon non vides), delete direct sinon. (12) Draft autosave: console.warn one-shot via _draftSaveFailed flag si quota localStorage depasse. (13) configPage.html: datetime-local placeholder='YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM' + pattern regex pour vieux Safari mobile sans support natif. INFRA: (14) escape_non_ascii.py utilise encoding='utf-8-sig' (strippe BOM auto). (15) check_version_coherence.py try/except sur parsing JSON/XML malformes -> exit 2 avec message clair. (16) WebhookNotifier SanitiseExceptionMessage + TryGetRetryAfterSeconds passees private->internal pour tests directs. TESTS: 13 nouveaux cas xUnit (SanitiseExceptionMessage 7 cas redaction URL+host, TryGetRetryAfterSeconds 4 cas null/cap60s/delta/pastdate, IsTargetedAtUser_DraftWithRoleAndUuidFilters regression guard, IsScheduleActive_Daily_MidnightWrap_ExactBoundaries). 266 v0.7.0 -> 279 v0.8.0. PAS DE MIGRATION : aucun nouveau champ, fixes defensifs uniquement.

v0.7.0 - Audit secondaire : 11 fixes (3 securite + 4 robustesse + 4 polish), 32 nouveaux tests xUnit (234 -> 266). (1) CRITIQUE banner.js checkTimeWindow overnight wrap : les banniers/annonces avec fenetre daily 22:00-06:00 retournaient toujours false, donc invisibles la nuit alors que le C# MatchesTimeWindow gerait correctement le wrap. Divergence client/serveur corrigee. (2) SSRF defense webhook URL : nouvelle helper IsWebhookHostSafe qui rejette loopback IPv4/IPv6 (127.0.0.0/8, ::1), link-local 169.254.0.0/16 (incl. AWS/Azure/GCP metadata endpoints), RFC1918 prive (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16), IPv6 ULA fc00::/7, hostnames .localhost/.internal/.local, et localhost literal. Appliquee sur SaveMaintenance webhook URL ET TestWebhook endpoint. (3) WebhookNotifier log sanitization : SanitiseExceptionMessage strippe les URLs+tokens du message exception avant logging (LogWarning ne contient plus la URL discord avec son token). TestAsync retourne message generique a l'admin UI au lieu de ex.Message qui pouvait leak hostnames internes via SSL cert errors. (4) Init defensif Announcements + AnnouncementsSeen avec = new() property-level (en plus du constructeur) : XmlSerializer peut bypasser le constructeur sur XML legacy nil tags, laissant ces props null et causant NRE. (5) ValidateSchedules WeekDays empty/null : au lieu de rejeter (regression v0.6.1), auto-normaliser type='always'. Preserve la compat avec configs legacy qui avaient ce cas comme 'never-active' silencieux. (6) DetectFormat URL host parsing au lieu de substring match : avant, 'https://relay.com/discord-bot/api/webhooks/proxy' etait classifie Discord (faux positif). Maintenant utilise Uri.Host exact match (incl. canary.discord.com, ptb.discord.com). (7) GetActiveSessions snapshot ToList avant LINQ : evite race condition sur _sessionManager.Sessions collection mutable. (8) ClonePublicFields rendu internal + reutilise par MaintenanceScheduleTask au lieu de son snapshot field-by-field qui manquait ScheduledStart/End/ActivatedAt. (9) WebhookNotifier 429 Retry-After : respecte le header (en seconds ou HTTP-date), retry si <= 4s d'attente. (10) Webhook payload size cap 32KB : evite Discord/Slack/proxy 400 sur payloads trop gros (admin avec customTitle+customSubtitle+message tres longs). (11) banner.js tick() defensive null check sur CONFIG : si fetch /config fail (plugin disabled mid-session, network blip), CONFIG reste null et chaque CONFIG.* etait NRE. (12) LastModified monotone : Math.Max(old, now) protege contre les horloges qui reculent (NTP correction). TESTS : 32 nouveaux (15 cas checkTimeWindow overnight JS, 7 SSRF blocklist hosts, 6 boundary public ranges, 5 DetectFormat regression guards substring-match, ValidateSchedules WeekDays auto-correct 2 cas, NormaliseCssColor bounds revisited). 234 -> 266 verts.

v0.6.1 - Hotfix install + audit logique. (1) CRITIQUE: fix sourceUrl lowercase typo qui cassait l'installation Jellyfin de v0.6.0 (GitHub URLs case-sensitive, 'maintenance-deluxe' lowercase -> 404). (2) AUDIT FIXES: 7 trous logiques cibles par l'audit pre-v0.6.1. (a) CSS .theme-custom ajoutee a admin.css avec vars CSS dynamiques pour preview admin du theme personnalise (avant : preview affichait velours par defaut, le theme custom n'etait visible que sur le client final). (b) ValidateSchedules etendu : valide les bornes coherence interne sur les 3 types : 'fixed' rejette FixedStart >= FixedEnd, 'annual' rejette mois hors [1,12] ou jour hors [1,31], 'weekly' rejette weekDays empty ou jours hors [0,6]. Avant : admin pouvait save des schedules muets qui ne matchaient jamais. (c) PLUGIN_VERSION constante au top d'admin.js (etait hardcodee '0.3.2.0' depuis 7 versions). (d) Sélecteur 'Personnalisé' disable + opacity 0.4 + tooltip explicatif tant que customTheme=null, avec auto-fallback velours si l'admin avait setce le theme custom puis supprime sa config. (e) Badge schedule incomplet en rouge dashed ('Fenetre fixe non configuree', 'Annuel non configure', 'Hebdo (aucun jour)') au lieu du badge bleu trompeur. (f) expireAfterDays clamp client-side 1-365 avec mise a jour de l'input (plus de surprise quand le serveur reduit a 365). (g) NormaliseCssColor : case-insensitive sur rgba (RGBA(...) accepte) + validation bounds R/G/B in [0,255] (avant : rgb(256,0,0) accepte produisait du CSS invalide silencieux). (3) REFACTOR: SAFE_URL_RE constante module-level dans banner.js, remplace 4 regex dupliques identiques (XSS protocol-relative defense). (4) UX: 2 nouveaux ANN_TEMPLATES quick-add 'Soiree Halloween' (schedule annual Oct 25-Nov 1) et 'Fin d'annee' (schedule annual Dec 20-Jan 5 wrap), template 'Nouveaux films' expireAfterDays=14 prefilled. (5) DOCS: docs/announcements.md mis a jour avec tableau Phase 2 features (carousel/stack/draft/expire/schedule/image/viewport/custom theme), tableau complet des 19 champs Announcement avec types et defaults, 'truth matrix' AND-combined des filtres de livraison, projection serveur de /announcements/active expliquee. (6) TESTS xUnit : 21 nouveaux cas. ValidateSchedules Theory (fixed inverted, fixed open-ended, annual out-of-range 6 cas, annual wrap valide, weekly empty, weekly null, weekly out-of-range 3 cas, daily no-constraint), NormaliseCssColor Theory (RGBA case-insensitive 2, rgb out-of-range 3, boundary 1). 213 tests v0.6.0 -> 234 tests v0.6.1. Marquee Companion.description: Adds server-side library filtering by media-stream characteristics that Jellyfin's core API can't express (video dynamic range, codecs, audio channel count, and spatial audio), opt-in recovery of missing release dates from file names or date added, authenticated Apple Watch media grants, and server-stored profile PINs. The filtering API exposes a paginated, BaseItemDto-compatible endpoint and a capability endpoint for client feature-detection. Release-date recovery is selected per library and can preview changes before applying them. Authenticated Apple podcast endpoints share a persistent read-through cache for charts, search, and lookup, retaining successful results when Apple is unavailable.
Marquee Companion.overview: Library filtering, cached Apple podcast APIs, Apple Watch media, and profile PINs.

versions.changelog:
- Initial release. - Resolution (isHd/is4K) passthrough for client filtering. - Fix: filtering by a library returned no items. The library (parentId) is now
  resolved into its contents so video range / codec / audio filters work when
  scoped to a specific library.
- Renamed the plugin to "Marquee Companion" (display name only; API route,
  plugin id, and behavior unchanged).
- Capabilities are now scoped to the requested library (parentId): the available
  values offered for a library are drawn only from items in that library, so any
  single facet selection is guaranteed to match at least one item there. Omitting
  parentId still returns the global value set.
- TV libraries now filter correctly by stream facets. Stream attributes live on
  episodes, but TV libraries are browsed at the series level; the filter now
  matches episodes and returns the shows that have at least one matching episode.
  Also forces a recursive query so a library id resolves to its contents.
- Added opt-in recent podcast discovery through Podcast Index. - Podcast discovery now logs why it returned nothing. The endpoint still answers 404 for
  every failure, but the server log distinguishes disabled credentials, a Podcast Index
  rejection, and feeds dropped during validation — including a per-rule tally of what was
  dropped.
- Removes the YouTube trailer resolver. Clients now hand YouTube trailers to the YouTube
  app instead, so the server no longer downloads, verifies, updates, or executes yt-dlp or a
  JavaScript runtime.
- Removes the yt-dlp and JavaScript-runtime downloads earlier versions installed. Those
  binaries are unreachable now the resolver is gone, so the plugin reclaims the directory it
  created rather than leaving an administrator to find it. Only its own install root is
  touched, and a failure to delete never stops the plugin starting.
- Fix: Podcast Discovery always returned 404 when enabled. Podcast Index sends the envelope's
  `status` as a JSON boolean, but it was bound to a string, so the whole recent-feeds payload
  failed to deserialize. Both the boolean and the documented string form are now accepted, and
  an unusable payload is logged with the value exactly as it arrived.
- Added opt-in email sign-in. A client posts an email address, the server mails a single-use
  link, and confirming that link signs the waiting device in — no password, and no typing on a
  TV remote. The email can be opened on any device, so it works for tvOS; when it is opened on
  the signing-in device itself, the confirmation page also offers a deep link straight back into
  the app. Unrecognised addresses can optionally register, in which case the new account is
  created disabled and copies an administrator-chosen template user's permissions, so nothing is
  accessible until an administrator enables it. SMTP host, port, security, credentials and
  from-address are configured in the plugin settings, along with link lifetime and rate limits;
  a "send test email" button reports the mail server's own error when submission fails. The
  endpoint reports an explicit error rather than a silent success when SMTP is not configured.
- Fix: an audio filter matched files that had each thing you asked for, but never in
  the same track. Asking for AC-3 in 5.1 returned 444 movies on a test library, of which
  only 247 had an AC-3 track that was itself 5.1 — the rest were "DTS 5.1 main track plus
  AC-3 2.0 commentary" files that answered "has AC-3" and "has six channels" separately.
  Codec, channel count and spatial format are now read per audio track and have to hold on
  ONE of them. A filter naming a single audio facet is unaffected. The values offered by
  /Capabilities are unchanged.
- Music libraries can now be filtered by codec and channel count. Tracks were never
  catalogued, so every audio filter over a music library returned nothing at all while the
  same library unfiltered returned 11,022 tracks.
- Release-date recovery reads the FILE NAME first and falls back to date added, and
  understands two-digit-year release names (Name.25.02.05.Title). Date added is when a
  file reached the server, not when it was released: on a 650-item dry run, leading with
  it produced 18 distinct dates with 605 identical, while the name gave 98 spanning 2013
  to 2026.
- Release-date recovery is chosen PER LIBRARY. - Added opt-in release-date recovery. Downloaded YouTube content carries its upload
  date only in the file name, so Jellyfin stores no premiere date and reads the leading
  YYYYMMDD as a production year like 20250823 — those items then cannot appear in any
  view ordered by release date, on any client. A new scheduled task, "Recover missing
  release dates", reads the date from the production-year stamp, an sYYYY.eMMDDnn name,
  or a bare YYYYMMDD run, and writes it along with the corrected year. Off by default,
  previews to the log until an administrator turns preview off, and never modifies an
  item that already has a release date.
- Adds the seamless Marquee Companion panel to Jellyfin Web without manual web-client changes. - Adds paired Jellyfin 10/.NET 9 and Jellyfin 12/.NET 10 package builds. - Removes podcast discovery and email sign-in, including their settings, API endpoints,
  and bundled mail dependencies. Existing email mappings and Jellyfin accounts are untouched.
- Organizes settings into Library filtering, Release dates, Apple Watch, and Profile PINs.
  Release-date recovery now uses Off, Preview only, or Apply changes; the task still runs
  from Dashboard > Scheduled Tasks.
- Adds authenticated read-through caching for all public Apple podcast chart, search,
  and lookup APIs, shared across users and retained through restarts. Failed Apple
  refreshes can serve the last successful result within the bounded stale window.

versions.changelog: Added support for 12.2

# 🎬 Media Bar Arrives on Jellyfin 12

Media Bar **3.0.0.0** brings support for **Jellyfin 12**, including compatibility with both the classic desktop experience and Jellyfin's newer modern web layout.

> ## 🙌 Huge thanks to MakD and the upstream contributors
>
> Media Bar itself is the work of **MakD and the contributors to the upstream Media Bar project**. The plugin I maintain is primarily a Jellyfin wrapper around that work, exposing configuration and integration points so it can be installed and managed cleanly as a Jellyfin plugin.
>
> A huge amount of effort has gone into keeping Media Bar working across Jellyfin's changing web interface, especially for Jellyfin 12. The features, UI work and frontend improvements in this release are built on that upstream work, and the credit for that belongs to **MakD and everyone contributing there**.
>
> My part is largely packaging, integrating and exposing that work through Jellyfin's plugin system.

## ✨ New Features

* Added support for **Jellyfin 12**.
* Added support for Jellyfin 12's **modern React/MUI home screen layout**, alongside the existing classic desktop layout.
* Updated the bundled Media Bar frontend to the latest Jellyfin 12-compatible upstream version.
* Added Jellyfin 12-specific styling so Media Bar integrates correctly with the new web-client shell while retaining the existing appearance on the classic layout.
* Media Bar continues to ship its frontend assets directly with the plugin, ensuring the version displayed in Jellyfin matches the plugin version you've installed.

## 🛠️ Improvements

* Synced Media Bar with the latest Jellyfin 12-compatible upstream work.
* Improved Media Bar placement within the Jellyfin 12 home screen across both supported layouts.
* Improved layout behaviour on taller displays, ensuring Jellyfin's home-screen rows remain below the Media Bar content rather than overlapping its controls.
* Improved localisation handling when loading Jellyfin's translation chunks.
* Retained support for the **Get updates early** option for users who explicitly want to track unreleased upstream Media Bar changes.

## 🪲 Bug Fixes

* Fixed Media Bar being inserted in the wrong position when using Jellyfin 12's modern layout (#181).
* Fixed translated Media Bar strings falling back to English or producing JSON decoding errors for some languages (#185).
* Fixed home-screen rows overlapping Media Bar buttons on taller viewports.
* Fixed Jellyfin 12 layout differences that could cause Media Bar to render incorrectly compared with Jellyfin 10.11.

## ⚠️ Compatibility

* **Media Bar 3.0.0.0 supports Jellyfin 10.11.11 and Jellyfin 12.**
* Users on older Jellyfin 10.x versions should remain on a compatible **2.x** Media Bar release.
* Jellyfin 12 support includes both the **classic Desktop layout** and the newer **modern React/MUI layout**.
* A compatible **File Transformation 3.x** release is required.
* If you're using the **Get updates early** option, unreleased upstream Media Bar changes may behave differently from the frontend bundled and tested with this plugin release.

## Contributors

* austinnorgaard
* judarange

## ❤️ Support

If you enjoy using my Jellyfin plugins and want to support the time that goes into building, maintaining, and improving them, you can do so on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/IAmParadox27).

Thank you for using the plugins and being part of the community.

✨ New Features

- Added an option to **enable or disable syncing the Jellyfin page backdrop with the current Media Bar slide** (#174).
- Media Bar's JavaScript and CSS are now **served directly from the installed plugin by default**, rather than being fetched from jsDelivr. This ensures the frontend always matches the installed plugin version and allows Media Bar to work without internet access (PR #175, @skylerwshaw).
- Added an optional **Get updates early** setting for users who want `main` or `latest` to continue tracking unreleased upstream changes through jsDelivr (PR #176, @skylerwshaw).
- Merged with upstream.

🛠️ Improvements

- Explicit version tags and commits can still be used to load a specific Media Bar version from jsDelivr, while the recommended default now uses the assets bundled with the plugin.
- Improved handling of embedded Media Bar assets, including correctly returning `404` for resources that don't exist.

🪲 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the slideshow timer lifecycle so changing slides doesn't inadvertently restart or leave behind an old timer (PR #178, @ACertainCoder).
- Fixed requests to `index.html` unexpectedly rewriting the saved Media Bar version configuration.
- Removed an unreachable legacy 10.11 asset fallback as part of the move to embedded frontend assets.

Contributors

- skylerwshaw
- ACertainCoder

✨ New Features

- Added support for 10.11.11

✨ New Features

- Added support for 10.11.9 and 10.11.10

✨ New Features

- Added support for 10.11.8

✨ New Features

- Added support for 10.11.7
- Due to the security warning issued with the release of 10.11.7, all previous 10.11.x versions have been discontinued effective immediately to promote upgrading to the more secure version
Hotfix to solve issue where trailer enable/disable toggle didn't work

- Added support for 10.11.6
- Merged with upstream

- Missed some more upstream improvements

Media Bar Enhanced.description: ▶ Feature-rich Media Bar fork that brings your home screen to life. ★ 100% Web UI control. ★ Backdrops: Cinematic full-width videos (YouTube/Local) with SponsorBlock (skip intros/outros (only YT Trailer)) and smart 'local-first' preference. ★ Dynamic Content: Display Playlists, Collections (Boxsets), or Seasonal holiday items. Sort by Random, Year, or Premiere Date with Parental Rating & Release Year filters. ★ Customization: Customizable overlays (branding/messages), pagination (dots/counter), and client-side settings to allow per-device overrides. ★ Advanced: Many settings for individual configuration. ⚠ Note: Requires 'file-transformation' plugin if write permissions are restricted.
